title: 第九章 黄耗子第十章 天生剑种
content_zh:
“醒啦，嗨，你小子，这次给打的不轻啊，伤还没好就歇歇，耽误两天也不妨事，别逞着强运炁。”
铁蛋爬起来，岳师兄正在篝火上烤鸡。
“对了，苑娘是谁？你作梦还在喊她哩，是你娘啊？”
铁蛋摇摇头，默不作声把枕下的铁剑拔出来，仔仔细细擦一遍。
剑长两尺，生铁打的，剑脊上用朱砂画了一道北辰金刀利剑符，虽不是什么法宝，只是岳师兄按着他的身高臂长，去铁匠铺买了把趁手的给他凑合用，不过剑就是剑，用来斩人的东西，昼夜都得养锋护刃，等到临阵再打磨肯定来不及的。
“啧，你小子真是，三棍子打不出个屁来，剑戳你都不吱一声的，可真是闷死了。”
岳鹏也是无奈，撕了条鸡腿给他。
铁蛋皱眉，
“哪儿来的鸡？”
“哦，我去前头绕了一圈，有个村，也不知遭了什么灾，一个人也没了，鸡倒是满村子乱窜。
我看这不是什么寻常野兽或者匪徒作乱，附近必有妖魔作怪，正好，杀妖取丹，给你寻宝筑基。”
铁蛋接过鸡腿看了看，
“妖魔？”
“哈？妖魔你都不知道？就是那些怪模怪样，杀人吃人的玩意喽。怎么，你没见过妖魔？”
铁蛋摇摇头。
“也对，见过你人早没了。北原大军坐镇，应该也不剩下什么妖魔了。”
岳鹏想了想，暴风吸入剩下的一条鸡腿，然后拿着鸡骨头，在地上画了个圈，
“这儿是光霞山。”
然后他又在光霞山那个圈外，南北东，画了三个大圈，
“南边是坤国的锦都城。北边是兑国的梁州府。东边是镇西军参宿卫，都是魔宫的地盘。”

然后他把骨头往篝火里一扔，在身上青衣擦擦手，
“其他地方，都是妖魔。”
“都是？”
铁蛋疑惑得皱眉，看看光霞山的圈儿，又看看北方的圈。
不是看梁州，是更北的北方。
岳鹏也知道他在奇怪什么，瞪着大小眼笑，
“有我们师兄弟俩把剑护着你们，一路上哪有不长眼的敢现身。好了，快吃，吃了动身。”
铁蛋看看岳师兄吃了没事，也把鸡腿啃了，把铁剑系在背上站起来。
但是岳鹏依旧蹲着没动，扯了条鸡翅膀，指指西南方，天色渐渐暗下来的山岭。
“我在这，那些玩意不敢出来的。村子在那个方向，你往前走，只管走，等那妖怪现身，把它斩了就是。若你自己能收拾，师兄就不帮你了。
如果搞不定，就大叫三声，好师兄，救救我！我就来救你。”
然后他又开始有滋有味地吮起翅膀了。
铁蛋也没二话，点点头，背着铁剑往鸡翅膀指的方向走。
天色渐渐暗下来，很快小路上的水坑都看不清了，夜里静谧的山岭，枯干乱叉的树枝，就犹如一个个张牙舞爪，非人非兽的怪形。
铁蛋倒是不怕走夜路，只是还不太习惯。
content_en:
"Wake up, hey, you kid, you were beaten quite hard this time. Just take a rest before the injury heals. It doesn't matter if you delay it for two days. Don't try to force your luck."
Tiedan got up, and Senior Brother Yue was roasting chicken on the campfire.
"By the way, who is Ms. Yuan? You are still calling her in your dream. Is she your mother?"
Tie Dan shook his head, silently pulled out the iron sword from under his pillow, and wiped it carefully.
The sword was two feet long and made of pig iron. There was a Beichen Golden Sword and Sharp Sword Talisman drawn on the spine with cinnabar. Although it was not a magic weapon, Brother Yue went to the blacksmith shop and bought a handy one for him to use based on his height and arm length. However, a sword is a sword. When it is used to kill people, it needs to be sharpened and protected day and night. It will definitely be too late to polish it before the battle.
"Tsk, you're such a kid. You can't beat me with three sticks, and you can't even make a sound when poked with a sword. You're really suffocating."
Yue Peng was helpless and tore a chicken leg to him.
Tiedan frowned,
"Where did the chicken come from?"
"Oh, I went around and saw a village. I don't know what kind of disaster it was. No one was dead. Chickens were running around all over the village.
I think this is not some ordinary beast or gangster causing trouble. There must be a demon nearby causing trouble. Just in time, kill the demon and get the elixir to find treasure and build a foundation for you. "
Tiedan took the chicken leg and looked at it,
"Demon?"
"Huh? You don't even know about monsters? They're just those weird looking things that kill and eat people. Why, you've never seen a monster?"
Tiedan shook his head.
"That's right, everyone who has seen you has long since disappeared. The Beiyuan army is here, and there shouldn't be any demons left."
Yue Peng thought for a while, then Baofeng inhaled the remaining chicken leg, then took the chicken bones and drew a circle on the ground.
"This is Guangxia Mountain."
Then he drew three large circles outside the circle in Guangxia Mountain, north, south, east,
"To the south is the Jindu City of the Kun Kingdom. To the north is the Liangzhou Mansion of the Dui Kingdom. To the east is the Zhenxi Army Rigel Guard. They are all the territory of the Demon Palace."
Then he threw the bones into the bonfire, wiped his hands on his green clothes,
"Everywhere else, there are monsters."
"Both?"
Tiedan frowned in confusion and looked at the circle in Guangxia Mountain and then at the circle in the north.
Not looking at Liangzhou, but further north.
Yue Peng also knew what he was wondering about, and smiled with wide eyes.
"With our two brothers and sisters guarding you with our swords, no one without a good eye would dare to show up along the way. Okay, eat quickly, eat and set off."
Seeing that Senior Brother Yue was fine, Tie Dan also gnawed the chicken legs, tied the iron sword on his back and stood up.
But Yue Peng still squatted without moving, pulled out a chicken wing, and pointed to the mountains in the southwest, where the sky was gradually darkening.
"I'm here, those things don't dare to come out. The village is in that direction, you go forward, just go, wait for the monster to show up and kill it. If you can take care of it yourself, senior brother won't help you.
If you can't handle it, just shout three times, "Good brother, help me!" I'm here to save you. "
Then he began to suck his wings again.
Tiedan didn't say anything, nodded, and walked in the direction pointed by Chicken Wings with the iron sword on his back.
The sky gradually darkened, and soon the puddles on the path were no longer visible. The quiet mountains at night and the dry and tangled branches looked like strange shapes with teeth and claws, neither human nor beast.
Tiedan is not afraid of walking at night, but he is not used to it yet.
